avoided.flip: It is mirrors face to face instead if the doubles are all present at once and nothing passes from clear to opaque.
avoided.why_not: Not reflections all present at once; the image clears and clouds.

secondary.name: Mark
secondary.question: What recurring thing has become meaningful because it repeats?
secondary.answer: Three embraces: the third makes the series and its meaning (she cannot be held).
secondary.operation: Match the three attempts exactly: same lens, same length.

avoided.name: Demark
avoided.flip: It is a demark instead if the shot shows one instance that breaks the established series: wrong place, wrong form, wrong time.
avoided.why_not: No term breaks the series; the series is the grief.

secondary.name: Icon
secondary.question: Where does intensity become a face?
secondary.answer: His grief as a face after the third embrace.
secondary.operation: Close on Odysseus after the third attempt, hold.

avoided.name: Bodies of attitude
avoided.flip: It is Body of attitude instead if the close attention falls on the body's postures, fatigue and waiting over duration — a body that carries time — rather than on a face expressing a feeling.
avoided.why_not: It is expression, not a waiting body.

scenes.title: Achilles Chooses Life in Retrospect

key_beat.note: the eulogy for Achilles

beats: Achilles approaches with Patroclus, Antilochus, and Ajax nearby.
Odysseus praises his honor among the dead, but Achilles rejects death's glory.
He asks about Peleus and Neoptolemus.
Odysseus recounts Neoptolemus's courage at Troy; Achilles strides away rejoicing.
Ajax alone refuses reconciliation and withdraws in silence.

primary.name: Sheets of the past
primary.question: Which layer of the past are we inhabiting?
primary.answer: The heroes of Troy, Achilles with Patroclus, Antilochus and Ajax, are the Iliad itself present as one layer of the past.
primary.operation: Track along the line of Troy's dead walking out of the mist together.

avoided.name: Peaks of the present
avoided.flip: It is peaks of the present instead if what coexists are nows, not strata of the past.
avoided.why_not: What coexists is a stratum of the past, not several presents.

secondary.name: Sonsign
secondary.image_type: Sonsign / pure actual sound situation (zeroness of the time-image, sound side)
secondary.question: Does this sound stand alone as a situation, answered by no action?
secondary.answer: Ajax's silence holds the situation: Odysseus speaks and is answered by no word and no act.
secondary.operation: Hold a wide as Ajax turns away without a word; no score, only the wind.

avoided.name: Binomial
avoided.flip: It is an action-image sign (binomial: situation → response) instead if the sound triggers a response: the alarm makes someone run, the phone is answered, the whistle ends the shift.
avoided.why_not: The silence triggers no response.

scenes.title: The Sirens' Song
beats: The wind dies as the ship approaches the Sirens' island.
Odysseus softens wax and seals every crewman's ears.
The men bind him upright to the mast and row past the flowered shore.
The Sirens promise total knowledge; Odysseus struggles and signals to be released.
Perimedes and Eurylochus tighten the ropes until the song fades.

primary.name: Sonsign
primary.image_type: Sonsign / pure actual sound situation (zeroness of the time-image, sound side)
primary.question: Does this sound stand alone as a situation, answered by no action?
primary.answer: The Sirens' song is the situation, and it is answered by no action: the only listener is bound to the mast.
primary.operation: Starve the image: a static wide of the ship passing the flowered shore while the song carries everything; close on Odysseus straining against the ropes.

avoided.name: Binomial
avoided.flip: It is an action-image sign (binomial: situation → response) instead if the sound triggers a response: the alarm makes someone run, the phone is answered, the whistle ends the shift.
avoided.why_not: The crew tightens the ropes in answer to his signal, not to the song.

secondary.name: Opsign
secondary.image_type: Opsign / pure actual optical situation (zeroness of the time-image, optical side)
secondary.question: Can this sight still be discharged into action?
secondary.answer: The deaf crew see a man writhing and a shore, and hear nothing: their image is to be seen and nothing more.
secondary.operation: Cut to the crew's view with the song dropped out entirely: oars, the shore, the bound man, silence.

avoided.name: Any-space-whatever
avoided.flip: It is an any-space-whatever instead if the disconnected space works as the ground of affect (shadow, colour, emptiness charging a feeling in a movement-image film) and the film then goes back into action.
avoided.why_not: The shot does not charge an affect that returns to action; it is pure seeing.

scenes.title: Between Scylla and Charybdis
beats: The crew hears Charybdis roar and sees spray rising from the whirlpool.
Odysseus keeps Scylla secret and orders the men to row hard along her cliff.
He arms himself despite Circe's warning and searches the rock face.
Scylla's six heads strike, lifting six screaming men from the ship.
The survivors pass beyond both monsters while watching their companions die above them.

primary.name: Originary world
primary.question: What ancient or pre-social force underlies this milieu?
primary.answer: The strait itself (whirlpool, cliff, cave) is an ancient force seizing bodies.
primary.operation: Wide from the cliff top down on the ship between the whirlpool and the rock; rotate the whirlpool's rings.

avoided.name: Any-space-whatever
avoided.flip: It is Any-space-whatever instead if the space is indeterminate — a void, a fog, a colour field — expressing a pure affective quality with no specific primal place and no pressure on bodies.
avoided.why_not: It is a determinate primal place that devours.

secondary.name: Symptom
secondary.question: What force is acting through this body?
secondary.answer: Six necks each seize one man: raw drive.
secondary.operation: Pose-to-pose on twos: the heads strike, lift six men up the cliff.

avoided.name: Imprint
avoided.flip: It is Imprint instead if the violent act is the release of pressure slowly accumulated from a complex social situation, legible through a long build and an emotional object.
avoided.why_not: No accumulated pressure; immediate seizing.

secondary.name: Icon
secondary.question: Where does intensity become a face?
secondary.answer: Odysseus watching his men die above him, calling his name.
secondary.operation: Close on his face turned up, the men out of frame.

avoided.name: Symptom
avoided.flip: It is Symptom instead if the facial intensity has already tipped into a primordial act — gnawing, biting, lunging, grabbing — the face as the site of an impulse too strong for the character.
avoided.why_not: His face stays; he cannot act.

scenes.title: The Island of the Sun
beats: The exhausted crew sees the cattle and sheep of Helios on Thrinacia.
Odysseus orders them to sail past, but Eurylochus accuses him of mercilessness.
The men swear to touch no livestock and land for one night.
A month of storm winds traps them while stores diminish.
Odysseus repeatedly reminds them of the oath.

primary.name: Bodies of attitude
primary.question: What does the body think before it acts?
primary.answer: A month of contrary winds: the crew's bodies waiting, starving, is the image.
primary.operation: Static wides of the crew on the shore over days, the stores shrinking, the light changing.

avoided.name: Figure of enfeeblement
avoided.flip: It is enfeeblement instead if the lassitude is the waning of a character's ability to act, measured against actions still expected.
avoided.why_not: The waiting is the posture, not a waning measured against an expected act (the winds, not weakness, stop them).

secondary.name: Binomial
secondary.question: Where has the world become a duel?
secondary.answer: Odysseus against Eurylochus: the crew divided.
secondary.operation: Shot/reverse on one axis at the landing.

avoided.name: Milieu
avoided.flip: It is Milieu instead if the figures are present only as instances of their world, with no opposition structuring the frame.
avoided.why_not: The frame is organised by the quarrel.

secondary.name: Fetish
secondary.question: What object has become charged?
secondary.answer: The sacred cattle are charged: they wait for the hands that will seize them.
secondary.operation: Insert of the herd grazing in sun, lit gold.

avoided.name: Mark
avoided.flip: It is Mark instead if the object's charge comes from habitual relation — it belongs to a familiar series (a cigarette case, a set of keys) and its meaning emerges when that series is recognised or broken.
avoided.why_not: They carry a force, not a habitual place in a series.

scenes.title: The Cattle Are Slaughtered
beats: When food is gone, Odysseus withdraws inland to pray and the gods put him to sleep.
Eurylochus persuades the crew to sacrifice the best cattle rather than starve.
They substitute oak leaves for barley and water for wine, kill the animals, and roast the meat.
The hides crawl and the meat bellows on the spits.
Lampetie tells Helios, who demands punishment from Zeus.

primary.name: Symptom
primary.question: What force is acting through this body?
primary.answer: Hunger seizes the crew: they kill the sacred cattle.
primary.operation: Close shots of the slaughter and roasting, pose-to-pose.

avoided.name: Fetish
avoided.flip: It is Fetish instead if the charge sits in an object the body has not yet seized — the scrap, shoe, relic held in insert — and no act has discharged it.
avoided.why_not: The object is already in the grip.

secondary.name: Demark
secondary.question: What breaks the pattern?
secondary.answer: The ritual with wrong terms (oak leaves for barley, water for wine) and then meat that bellows on the spits: terms out of place.
secondary.operation: Frame the substitutions as inserts, then hold the spits in a regular row with one hide crawling.

avoided.name: Mark
avoided.flip: It is a mark instead if the term appears where and as the series predicts.
avoided.why_not: The terms contradict the series.

direction.insert_object: the bellowing meat on the spits
direction.subject: eurylochus

scenes.title: Zeus Destroys the Last Ship
beats: Odysseus wakes, smells the meat, and condemns the act, but the crew feasts for six days.
On the seventh day the wind falls and the ship leaves Thrinacia.
Zeus gathers a black cloud and strikes the mast with lightning.
The ship shatters and every crewman drowns; Odysseus lashes keel and mast together.
Driven back to Charybdis, he hangs from the fig tree until the timbers reemerge, then drifts alone to Calypso.

primary.name: Figure of enfeeblement
primary.question: Is the actor tiny compared with the world disclosed?
primary.answer: The sole survivor on a keel, then hanging from a fig tree over the whirlpool: a speck against an immense sea.
primary.operation: Extreme wide: the fig tree on the cliff, the tiny man hanging, Charybdis turning below; pull back.

avoided.name: Quotidian
avoided.flip: It is Quotidian instead if the small acts are neither futile nor merely revelatory but carry their own petty heroism, so trivial and immense can't be separated.
avoided.why_not: His acts have no petty heroism; they are the smallness of a man in a world.

secondary.name: Originary world
secondary.question: What ancient or pre-social force underlies this milieu?
secondary.answer: The storm and Charybdis are the old forces that take the ship.
secondary.operation: Wide on the black cloud and lightning striking the mast.

avoided.name: Any-space-whatever
avoided.flip: It is Any-space-whatever instead if the space is indeterminate — a void, a fog, a colour field — expressing a pure affective quality with no specific primal place and no pressure on bodies.
avoided.why_not: The storm presses on bodies.

secondary.name: Bodies of attitude
secondary.question: What does the body think before it acts?
secondary.answer: Hanging from the fig until the timbers come back is a body waiting.
secondary.operation: Hold on him hanging, only the whirlpool moving.

avoided.name: Figure of enfeeblement
avoided.flip: It is enfeeblement instead if the lassitude is the waning of a character's ability to act, measured against actions still expected.
avoided.why_not: Here the body holds, and time is the content.

scenes.title: The Phaeacians Carry Odysseus Home
beats: Odysseus finishes his tale and the Phaeacians sit in silence.
Alcinous orders additional gifts packed in a chest and the farewell feast begins.
At sunset Odysseus boards the convoy ship and lies on a prepared bed in the stern.
The ship runs faster than a hawk while he sleeps and reaches Ithaca before dawn.
The crew carries the sleeping man and his treasure onto the shore.

primary.name: Bodies of attitude
primary.question: What does the body think before it acts?
primary.answer: He sleeps like death in the stern and is carried ashore without waking: a body with no act, the posture of the voyage ending.
primary.operation: Top shot on the sleeper on the stern bed as the ship runs; then the crew lifting him ashore, he does not wake; hold.

avoided.name: Figure of enfeeblement
avoided.flip: It is enfeeblement instead if the lassitude is the waning of a character's ability to act, measured against actions still expected.
avoided.why_not: His sleep is not measured against an act the film expects; it is the end of acts.

secondary.name: Mise en abyme
secondary.question: Is one action-world nested inside another?
secondary.answer: The tales close: the nested world folds back into the hushed hall.
secondary.operation: Pull back from Odysseus's face to the silent Phaeacian hall, the listeners still, before the first word.

avoided.name: Theatrical figure
avoided.flip: It is Theatrical instead if the nested performance has a clear outside: one real action that the play-within points toward.
avoided.why_not: The frame closes on the listeners; no real action is being rehearsed.

scenes.title: Odysseus Wakes on an Unknown Shore

key_beat.note: all of it here, nothing taken

beats: Odysseus wakes after the ship has gone and fails to recognize Ithaca because Athena covers it in mist.
He counts the Phaeacian gifts and fears he has been cheated or abandoned elsewhere.
He walks the unfamiliar shore grieving and searching for signs.
Athena approaches disguised as a young shepherd.

primary.name: Any-space-whatever
primary.question: Has place stopped functioning as ordinary geography?
primary.answer: Athena's mist makes Ithaca a place that no longer functions as geography: he cannot tell his own harbour.
primary.operation: Empty wide of the harbour in fog, the olive and the cave unreadable; then the tiny figure waking in it.

avoided.name: Originary world
avoided.flip: It is Originary world instead if the space is a determinate archetypal place — this desert, this forest, the house — charged with primal forces that are about to seize bodies, under a time of decay.
avoided.why_not: The fog is indeterminate; it does not press on him with menace.

secondary.name: Mark
secondary.question: What recurring thing has become meaningful because it repeats?
secondary.answer: He counts the gifts, tripod after cauldron, to see if anything is missing: 'all of it here'.
secondary.operation: Matched inserts of each treasure as he touches it.

avoided.name: Demark
avoided.flip: It is a demark instead if the shot shows one instance that breaks the established series: wrong place, wrong form, wrong time.
avoided.why_not: Nothing is out of place; the count completes.

scenes.title: The Cretan Lie Meets Its Match

key_beat.note: where were you all the salt years

beats: The shepherd tells Odysseus he is in Ithaca and the hero suppresses his joy.
He invents a Cretan identity and a story of killing a king's son and fleeing by Phoenician ship.
Athena laughs, changes to her divine form, and praises his incurable cunning.
Odysseus tests her loyalty and complains that she abandoned him after Troy.
She explains that Poseidon's anger required concealment rather than open rescue.

primary.name: Limpid and opaque
primary.question: Which side of the image is becoming real?
primary.answer: The shepherd clouds and the goddess clears, while his Cretan face slides over his own: two images trade places.
primary.operation: Hold a two-shot; replace the shepherd with Athena on twos as she laughs; his grin breaks through the lie in the same frame.

avoided.name: Mirrors face to face
avoided.flip: It is mirrors face to face instead if the doubles are all present at once and nothing passes from clear to opaque.
avoided.why_not: Not reflections at once; one face passes into the other.

secondary.name: Powers of the false
secondary.question: What if contradiction generates rather than obstructs the story?
secondary.answer: The Cretan tale is the first of several false lives he will tell (XIII, XIV, XVII, XIX, XXIV); the versions do not agree.
secondary.operation: Play the lie straight, as testimony, in a steady close; do not mark it as false.

avoided.name: Demark
avoided.flip: It is a demark instead if one aberrant item breaks a logic that is then restored by thinking it through.
avoided.why_not: No single aberrant item is corrected; the versions multiply.

scenes.title: The Treasure Is Hidden
beats: Athena helps Odysseus carry the gifts into the cave of the nymphs.
She seals the cave entrance with a stone and sits with him beneath the olive tree.
They count the suitors and devise a concealment strategy.
Athena tells him to go first to Eumaeus while she retrieves Telemachus from Sparta.

primary.name: Symbol
primary.question: What idea is being thought through this thing?
primary.answer: The olive at the head of the harbour, over the sealed cave, is the knot of the film's threads: the olive stake, the olive bushes at Scheria, the olive bed.
primary.operation: Low wide of Athena and Odysseus beneath the olive; insert of its trunk; the same trunk framing returns for the bed in XXIII.

avoided.name: Mark
avoided.flip: It is a mark instead if the object only recurs as one term of a single habitual series.
avoided.why_not: The olive carries an idea (rootedness, home), not just a place in a series.

secondary.name: Cinema of the brain
secondary.question: Has the screen itself become a thinking system?
secondary.answer: They count the suitors and plan: the hall drawn as a map in the sand, the plan as a diagram of thought.
secondary.operation: Overhead shot of the sand under the olive: Athena's spear draws the hall; studs for the suitors.

avoided.name: Milieu
avoided.flip: It is a milieu instead if the environment determines characters' behaviour as a real situation to resolve.
avoided.why_not: The drawing is a mental map, not a real situation to act in.

scenes.title: Athena Makes the Beggar

key_beat.note: she relishes the disguise she is building

beats: Athena touches Odysseus with her wand and shrivels his skin, hair, and limbs.
She clouds his eyes, dresses him in filthy rags, and gives him a staff and patched bag.
The transformed king is instructed to test servants without being recognized.
Athena departs for Sparta and Odysseus walks toward Eumaeus's farm.

primary.name: Limpid and opaque
primary.question: Which side of the image is becoming real?
primary.answer: The king clouds and the beggar clears: the central exchange of the second half.
primary.operation: Replacement on twos as the wand touches him: skin, hair, eyes, rags swapped one element at a time in one held medium.

avoided.name: Rich dream
avoided.flip: It is a rich dream instead if the obscure side is marked as a character's dream with a clear waking frame around it.
avoided.why_not: No dreamer frames it; it is the image itself turning.

secondary.name: Bodies of gest
secondary.question: How do postures become social relations?
secondary.answer: The rags, the staff and the bag take the king's body into the social ritual of beggary.
secondary.operation: Frontal medium as Athena hands him the staff and bag; he assumes the stoop.

avoided.name: Bodies of attitude
avoided.flip: It is a body of attitude instead if the body stays in one posture with no linkage into a performed act.
avoided.why_not: The posture becomes a performed social role.

scenes.title: The Dogs at Eumaeus's Yard
beats: Odysseus approaches Eumaeus's remote pig farm in disguise.
Four savage dogs rush him and he drops his staff and sits to avoid attack.
Eumaeus runs out, scatters the dogs with stones, and brings the stranger inside.
He offers his own seat and prepares two young pigs for a meal.

primary.name: Milieu
primary.question: What world produces these actions?
primary.answer: Eumaeus's yard, stone-walled sties and herds, is the world of the loyal servant laid out before the scene acts.
primary.operation: Wide of the farm: walls, twelve sties, the hut; the beggar small at the gate.

avoided.name: Binomial
avoided.flip: It is Binomial instead if the frame is organised by two opposed forces squaring off (two camps, two lines, a standoff) so the setting is only the stage of a duel.
avoided.why_not: The frame is the farm, not a duel.

secondary.name: Binomial
secondary.question: Where has the world become a duel?
secondary.answer: Four dogs rush the stranger; he sits and drops his staff: a duel refused.
secondary.operation: Low shot along the axis of the dogs' rush to the sitting beggar.

avoided.name: Milieu
avoided.flip: It is Milieu instead if the figures are present only as instances of their world, with no opposition structuring the frame.
avoided.why_not: The frame is organised by the charge.

scenes.title: The Swineherd Laments His Master

key_beat.note: kind to me past any telling

beats: Eumaeus apologizes for the humble food and curses the suitors who consume Odysseus's best animals.
He speaks of the absent king with loyalty and refuses to believe hopeful travelers' stories.
Odysseus swears that the master will return within the year.
Eumaeus rejects the prediction but continues to honor the stranger.

primary.name: Quotidian
primary.question: Has everyday life become both ridiculous and heroic?
primary.answer: A slave's humble supper shared with a beggar-king: everyday and heroic at once.
primary.operation: Static medium on the two at the meal, long hold, no cutting on lines.

avoided.name: Figure of enfeeblement
avoided.flip: It is Enfeeblement instead if the act reads plainly as futile and the world plainly as overwhelming.
avoided.why_not: Nothing is futile; the hospitality is the heroism.

secondary.name: Index of equivocity
secondary.question: What two worlds could explain the same action?
secondary.answer: The beggar's oath that Odysseus will return reads as flattery to Eumaeus and as the king's own promise to us.
secondary.operation: Hold the two-shot so both readings stay in view.

avoided.name: Index of lack
avoided.flip: It is Index of lack instead if a later action resolves which situation is true and the character reorients on that single reading.
avoided.why_not: Nothing resolves it until XXI.

secondary.name: Icon
secondary.question: Where does intensity become a face?
secondary.answer: Eumaeus's face: 'kind to me past any telling'.
secondary.operation: Close on Eumaeus as he speaks of his master.

avoided.name: Dividual
avoided.flip: It is Dividual instead if the face is one of a series of faces or bodies that together express one collective emotion, the individual standing in for the mass.
avoided.why_not: His grief alone.

scenes.title: Athena Wakes Telemachus

key_beat.note: go first to the swineherd

beats: Athena appears to Telemachus in Sparta and orders him to return before Penelope is forced to marry.
She warns that the suitors wait in ambush and gives a route that avoids the strait.
She tells him to land secretly and go first to Eumaeus's hut.
Telemachus wakes Pisistratus and prepares to depart at dawn.

primary.name: Vector
primary.question: How do several incomplete situations compose a world?
primary.answer: The son's thread is cut back in, each road incomplete until the hut.
primary.operation: Cut to Sparta at night: Athena at the bedside, the map of the route; end on Telemachus waking Pisistratus.

avoided.name: Index of equivocity
avoided.flip: It is Index of equivocity instead if the film has one principal character facing a two-sided situation rather than a multiplicity of disclosers.
avoided.why_not: Not one hero's double situation; two lines converging.

scenes.title: Telemachus Lands in Secret

key_beat.note: take her round without me

beats: As the ship approaches Ithaca, a hawk tears a dove beside Telemachus.
Theoclymenus reads the omen as proof that Odysseus's line will remain supreme.
Telemachus orders the crew to take the ship to town while he lands near Eumaeus's farm.
He entrusts Theoclymenus to Piraeus and walks inland alone.

primary.name: Plastic figure
primary.question: What greater situation does this action unexpectedly imply?
primary.answer: The hawk tearing a dove stands, in one stroke, for the slaughter to come.
primary.operation: Insert of the hawk and dove over the deck, one sharp action; cut to faces.

avoided.name: Theatrical figure
avoided.flip: It is Theatrical instead if the figure is not a single substituted image but a staged fictitious action (a play, game, rehearsal, parody) that runs over a sequence and prefigures a real act the film keeps deferring.
avoided.why_not: One image, not a staged sequence.

secondary.name: Vector
secondary.question: How do several incomplete situations compose a world?
secondary.answer: The threads divide: the ship to town, the prince inland alone.
secondary.operation: Wide as the ship pulls away and Telemachus walks up the beach.

avoided.name: Liquid perception
avoided.flip: It is Liquid perception instead if the ensemble is only a flow of perceived centres with no situation being disclosed by their actions.
avoided.why_not: Situations are disclosed, not just a flow.

scenes.title: The Son Reaches the Hut

key_beat.note: keep your seat, stranger

beats: Telemachus approaches Eumaeus's farm and the dogs greet him without aggression.
Eumaeus recognizes him, drops his bowl, and kisses him like a father receiving a lost son.
The disguised Odysseus rises and offers his seat.
Telemachus asks for news and enters the hut beside the unknown beggar.

primary.name: Demark
primary.question: What breaks the pattern?
primary.answer: The dogs that rushed every stranger are silent and fawn: the aberration tells Odysseus a known person is coming before he sees him.
primary.operation: Hold on the dogs in the same framing as their rush in XIV-S01; now they wag; then Odysseus's head turns.

avoided.name: Mark
avoided.flip: It is a mark instead if the term appears where and as the series predicts.
avoided.why_not: The term contradicts the series.

secondary.name: Icon
secondary.question: Where does intensity become a face?
secondary.answer: Eumaeus kisses Telemachus like a father receiving a lost son, while the true father watches.
secondary.operation: Close on Eumaeus's face; the beggar soft in the background.

avoided.name: Dividual
avoided.flip: It is Dividual instead if the face is one of a series of faces or bodies that together express one collective emotion, the individual standing in for the mass.
avoided.why_not: One man's feeling.

scenes.title: The Father Reveals Himself

key_beat.note: you are not my father; this is terror, not doubt

beats: Athena restores Odysseus's strength, clothing, skin, and dark hair outside the hut.
He reenters transformed; Telemachus recoils, believing he is a god.
Odysseus declares himself the father for whom Telemachus has suffered.
Telemachus doubts him until Odysseus explains Athena's control of his appearance.
They embrace and weep with the force of birds robbed of their young.

primary.name: Limpid and opaque
primary.question: Which side of the image is becoming real?
primary.answer: The beggar clears into the father: Telemachus asks which side is real, god or man.
primary.operation: Hold one medium as he re-enters, restored; cut to Telemachus recoiling; back to the father, unchanged; the image refuses to settle.

avoided.name: Mirrors face to face
avoided.flip: It is mirrors face to face instead if the doubles are all present at once and nothing passes from clear to opaque.
avoided.why_not: One face passes into the other.

secondary.name: Icon
secondary.question: Where does intensity become a face?
secondary.answer: Telemachus's terror: 'you are not my father'.
secondary.operation: Close on Telemachus held long.

avoided.name: Symptom
avoided.flip: It is Symptom instead if the facial intensity has already tipped into a primordial act — gnawing, biting, lunging, grabbing — the face as the site of an impulse too strong for the character.
avoided.why_not: The intensity does not become an act.

scenes.note: Not strong destiny: Telemachus has no memory of his father; this recognition happens without recollection.

scenes.title: The Plan against the Suitors

key_beat.note: counting a hundred and eight men he intends to fight

beats: Odysseus tells how the Phaeacians returned him and asks for the exact number of suitors.
Telemachus lists the factions and warns that two men cannot fight so many.
Odysseus names Zeus and Athena as allies and lays out the weapons-removal plan.
Telemachus must return to the palace, endure insults, and tell no one—not even Penelope or Laertes.
They assign Eumaeus to bring the beggar later.

primary.name: Cinema of the brain
primary.question: Has the screen itself become a thinking system?
primary.answer: The plan against 108 men is laid out as a map: the hall as a diagram of thought.
primary.operation: Overhead on the hut floor: the hall drawn, suitors as studs in four colours by faction; the camera stays above.

avoided.name: Milieu
avoided.flip: It is a milieu instead if the environment determines characters' behaviour as a real situation to resolve.
avoided.why_not: It is a mental map, not a situation to act in yet.

secondary.name: Mark

distribution.name: Solid perception
distribution.question: Whose world is this?
distribution.gloss: all images revolve around a central and privileged image
distribution.operation: Bind the camera to one perceiver's eyes, then turn it round to look at that body, until every image in the film orbits a single subject.

distribution.name: Liquid perception
distribution.question: Does perception migrate?
distribution.gloss: the flow from character/event to character/event
distribution.operation: Keep the camera moving and never cut: follow one person until someone else crosses the frame, then let them carry the shot onward.

distribution.name: Gaseous perception
distribution.question: Can the world perceive without a human center?
distribution.gloss: all images resonate with one another as an acentred system
distribution.operation: Take the human out of the centre: speed up, slow down, multiply and superimpose images until the frame perceives like matter rather than a person.

distribution.name: Icon
distribution.question: Where does intensity become a face?
distribution.gloss: the face expressing unfilmable internal intensities
distribution.operation: Move in until the face fills the frame and hold it past the point of information, so expression becomes the event.

distribution.name: Dividual
distribution.question: Is the feeling mine, ours, or both?
distribution.gloss: the conjunction of collective and individual affects
distribution.operation: Pan across a gathering until the faces merge into one feeling, then find the one face that carries the whole crowd.

distribution.name: Any-space-whatever
distribution.question: Has place stopped functioning as ordinary geography?
distribution.gloss: the expression of non-human affects
distribution.operation: Empty the frame of people and hold on the space – fog, rain, ruin, glare – until the place itself becomes the feeling.

distribution.name: Symptom
distribution.question: What force is acting through this body?
distribution.gloss: characters overwhelmed by primal forces
distribution.operation: Film a body taken over by appetite – eating, grabbing, crawling – so the act comes before any thought.

distribution.name: Fetish
distribution.question: What object has become charged?
distribution.gloss: a special object charged with primal energies, awaiting a grounding
distribution.operation: Isolate one object in close-up and light it as if it holds a power, so the frame waits for someone to touch it.

distribution.name: Originary world
distribution.question: What ancient or pre-social force underlies this milieu?
distribution.gloss: a universe of primal forces
distribution.operation: Frame the forest, desert or old house as something older than the story, and let it swallow the figures who cross it.

distribution.name: Index of lack
distribution.question: What missing situation does this action let us infer?
distribution.gloss: the situation is an ellipsis which is unequivocally revealed
distribution.operation: Withhold what is really happening and let a searcher's hands and eyes uncover it piece by piece until one image settles the question.

distribution.name: Index of equivocity
distribution.question: What two worlds could explain the same action?
distribution.gloss: the situation is revealed as ambiguous
distribution.operation: Stage one gesture so it points to two incompatible situations at once, and refuse to let the film choose between them.

distribution.name: Vector
distribution.question: How do several incomplete situations compose a world?
distribution.gloss: multiple situations within the homogeneous universe
distribution.operation: Cut between several characters on separate missions through one place, and let each thread leave a gap that another thread fills.

distribution.name: Milieu
distribution.question: What world produces these actions?
distribution.gloss: the situation explicated through character actions
distribution.operation: Open wide on the whole social and geographic world, and only then let people move inside it as expressions of that world.

distribution.name: Binomial
distribution.question: Where has the world become a duel?
distribution.gloss: a whole world of duels
distribution.operation: Split the world into two sides, give each a face, and cut back and forth between them until they meet in a confrontation.

distribution.name: Imprint
distribution.question: How has the world gotten inside the character?
distribution.gloss: an indelible impression of the world upon a character
distribution.operation: Load the character with the world scene by scene, give that pressure one object to hold, and let the release come late and violently.

distribution.name: Plastic figure
distribution.question: What greater situation does this action unexpectedly imply?
distribution.gloss: small form transformed by the large form, an implied situation
distribution.operation: Let one object or eruption stand in for the situation you refuse to show directly.

distribution.name: Theatrical figure
distribution.question: What real action is being rehearsed through fiction?
distribution.gloss: a sequence of images as precursor of the real action
distribution.operation: Stage the real conflict as a game, play or mock battle, and repeat it until it stands in for the fight itself.

distribution.name: Mise en abyme
distribution.question: Is one action-world nested inside another?
distribution.gloss: a recurrence of plastic and theatrical figures
distribution.operation: Nest the scene inside a replica of itself (screen, model, mirror, loop) until the frame and the framed trade places.

distribution.name: Figure of the sublime
distribution.question: Is the action bigger than the world requires?
distribution.gloss: actions surpass the determinates of an enfeebled situation
distribution.operation: Give a small person an absurdly grand plan and film the plan's execution with total solemnity.

distribution.name: Figure of enfeeblement
distribution.question: Is the actor tiny compared with the world disclosed?
distribution.gloss: weak characters reveal the sublime nature of the world
distribution.operation: Shrink the character in the frame and give them nothing to do, until the world around them becomes the event.

distribution.name: Quotidian
distribution.question: Has everyday life become both ridiculous and heroic?
distribution.gloss: everyday situations, everyday actions – sublime ↔ futile
distribution.operation: Hold a static medium shot on an ordinary gesture long enough for the world outside the frame to press in.

distribution.name: Limit of the large form action-image
distribution.question: What hidden question does this world contain?
distribution.gloss: action explores a hidden problem
distribution.operation: Set up the fight, then turn the camera until the audience is no longer sure which side is the monster.

distribution.name: Limit of the small form action-image
distribution.question: Why do the clues refuse to settle the situation?
distribution.gloss: the situation revealed as a problem
distribution.operation: Cut parallel lines of action that never meet, and let the one moment they share space explain nothing.

distribution.name: Limit of the action-image (extreme limit)
distribution.question: Has action itself stopped being an adequate solution?
distribution.gloss: a whole world of problems
distribution.operation: Let two incompatible modes of the same story reflect on each other until the only thing left on screen is the problem itself.

distribution.name: Rich dream
distribution.question: Can we clearly tell when the dream begins?
distribution.gloss: radically distinct real world and dream world
distribution.operation: Mark the passage into sleep with an optical transformation and fill the dream with images only trick photography can make.

distribution.name: Restrained dream
distribution.question: Are we unsure whether waking has ended?
distribution.gloss: an ambiguity between real world and dream world
distribution.operation: Cut straight from waking to dream with no optical signal, and let one ordinary object behave slightly wrongly.

distribution.name: Movement of world
distribution.question: What if nobody ever wakes up?
distribution.gloss: the dream world is the real world
distribution.operation: Make the whole world move to one impossible rhythm so that no one stands outside the dream.

distribution.name: Strong destiny
distribution.question: Does the remembered past command what happens next?
distribution.gloss: a flashback to the past determines the future
distribution.operation: Hold on a face in the present, dissolve slowly into a marked past, and return with that past driving the next act.

distribution.name: Weak destiny
distribution.question: Does memory color the present without dictating it?
distribution.gloss: the content of the flashback permeates affects
distribution.operation: Slip into the past without a transition, let the flashback wander to other characters, and leave the present waiting in transit.

distribution.name: Forking paths
distribution.question: Which past, if any, actually explains the present?
distribution.gloss: a matrix of irresolvable flashbacks
distribution.operation: Build loops that fork within themselves: double the figure, pass through the mirror, and return to the start changed.

distribution.name: Mark
distribution.question: What recurring thing has become meaningful because it repeats?
distribution.gloss: the relation between a habitual series of images
distribution.operation: Repeat one kind of image three times so the audience starts reading every new shot as the next term.

distribution.name: Demark
distribution.question: What breaks the pattern?
distribution.gloss: an aberration in the series of habitual images
distribution.operation: Set up a regular series, then let one term appear where it cannot belong.

distribution.name: Symbol
distribution.question: What idea is being thought through this thing?
distribution.gloss: an object expressing ideas, beliefs, concepts
distribution.operation: Isolate one concrete object and let every relation in the film pass through it.

distribution.name: Opsign
distribution.question: Can this sight still be discharged into action?
distribution.gloss: the zeroness of the time-image: a pure optical situation
distribution.operation: Fix the camera on a place, object or onlooker where nothing is meant to happen and hold the image until what is seen stops leading anywhere.
distribution.image_type: Opsign / pure actual optical situation (zeroness of the time-image, optical side)

distribution.name: Sonsign
distribution.question: Does this sound stand alone as a situation, answered by no action?
distribution.gloss: the zeroness of the time-image: a pure sound situation
distribution.operation: Take away the action and let a sound hold the scene: starve the image, or freeze the listener, until what is heard is the situation instead of an accompaniment or a signal to act.
distribution.image_type: Sonsign / pure actual sound situation (zeroness of the time-image, sound side)

distribution.name: Mirrors face to face
distribution.question: Which image is original?
distribution.gloss: fragments, duplicates and distortions
distribution.operation: Put two reflecting surfaces into the shot so that the body appears more than once and one copy is not quite the original.

distribution.name: Limpid and opaque
distribution.question: Which side of the image is becoming real?
distribution.gloss: the exchange of the actual and virtual
distribution.operation: Cut between a person rehearsing and the same person in the finished role until you can't tell which is performing.

distribution.name: Seed and environment
distribution.question: What future world lies virtually inside this image?
distribution.gloss: (virtual/actual) seed ↔ (actual/virtual) environment
distribution.operation: Show a small object that holds a whole world in miniature, then let the full-size world grow out of it.

distribution.name: Peaks of the present
distribution.question: What if several presents are simultaneously valid?
distribution.gloss: the heterogeneous present
distribution.operation: Show the same moment twice, happening in two ways that can't both be true, and don't choose between them.

distribution.name: Sheets of the past
distribution.question: Which layer of the past are we inhabiting?
distribution.gloss: the non-chronological nature of the past
distribution.operation: Track one long unbroken shot through a building where each room belongs to a different decade.

distribution.name: Powers of the false
distribution.question: What if contradiction generates rather than obstructs the story?
distribution.gloss: serialism, the ongoing ungrounding of the image
distribution.operation: Film a sincere face-to-camera testimony, then give the same words to an actor, and never mark where the switch happens.

distribution.name: Bodies of attitude
distribution.question: What does the body think before it acts?
distribution.gloss: a dispersed individuation of the body
distribution.operation: Film the body between actions, waiting, slumping, fidgeting, and let several different bodies stand in for one person.

distribution.name: Bodies of gest
distribution.question: How do postures become social relations?
distribution.gloss: the linkage of attitudes creating differentiation
distribution.operation: Take an everyday body into a ritual (an office, a uniform, a ceremony) and hold the frame until the ritual has swallowed the person.

distribution.name: Cinema of the brain
distribution.question: Has the screen itself become a thinking system?
distribution.gloss: the screen as a cerebral space
distribution.operation: Draw the town on the floor and shoot it from above, so the set works like a diagram of thought.

distribution.name: Lectosigns
distribution.question: What must I read here that I cannot simply see?
distribution.gloss: the infinite of the time-image
distribution.operation: Take away every link between shots and leave the viewer to read the sequence like a text.
distribution.image_type: Lectosigns / the readable image (infinite of the time-image)

compounds.formula: Mi - Ic - Lq ~ Ve - Th > Ba
compounds.name: Two-road ion
compounds.reading: The council's milieu (Mi) bonds to the icon (Ic: Athena's appeal, Helen's recognition); the icon to liquid perception (Lq: the descent from Olympus, the night launch), which resonates with the vector (Lq ~ Ve, the table's own hinge: the two roads either as a travelling camera or as disclosed situations). The vector bonds to the theatrical figure (Th: Orestes and the Troy beggar rehearsing Book XXII), which breaks (>) into bodies of attitude (Ba: Odysseus on Ogygia's shore). Mi, Ve and Ba stay radicals, open to the acts that follow.

compounds.formula: Qu # En - Lq - Mi - Dm - Ma
compounds.name: Phaeacian inversion chain
compounds.reading: The quotidian rhymes with enfeeblement (Qu # En, both inversion-images: the castaway who is a speck in the surf, the girls washing clothes), then passes through liquid perception (the walk through Scheria) into the Phaeacian milieu (Mi), the demark of Arete's cloth (Dm) and the mise en abyme of the bard's song (Ma). pT 0: the only act whose compound holds no time-image.

compounds.formula: Bi - Sy # Fe > Ba - Or - Im
compounds.name: Fetish-and-originary chain
compounds.reading: The duel (Bi) bonds to the symptom (Sy: the giant eating, the crew devouring cattle), which rhymes with the fetish (Sy # Fe, the impulse-image's own column: the stake, the bag of winds, the lotus). The fetish breaks (>) into bodies of attitude (Ba: the lotus-eaters, the crew waiting on Thrinacia) and returns to the originary world (Or: the cave, the harbour, the strait) and the imprint (Im: the blinding). The Nekyia's sheets of the past and the Sirens' sonsign fall under the 0.06 threshold: too short to enter the compound, which is the finding.

compounds.formula: Lo ~ Pf - Qu - Ie # Ve - Im
compounds.name: Crystal of disguise
compounds.reading: The highest pT of the film (5.8). Limpid and opaque (Lo: every transformation of Odysseus and every Athena) resonates with powers of the false (Lo ~ Pf, the Cretan lies), bonds to the quotidian (Qu: the swineherd's supper), the index of equivocity (Ie: the beggar's oath), which rhymes with the vector (Ie # Ve: father and son converging) and the imprint (Im: the stool and the kick, stored).

compounds.formula: Sb # Mk > Bg - Il - Bi - Ve
compounds.name: The bow series
compounds.reading: The symbol (Sb: the bow) rhymes with the mark (Mk: axes in a line, suitors failing one by one; both relation-images), which breaks into bodies of gest (Bg: the contest as rite, the supplications); then the index of lack (Il: the scar, the empty pegs), the duel (Bi, 31% of the act) and the vector (Ve: the doors, the storeroom, Melanthius). Sb and Ve stay radical.

atoms.name: Limit of the large form action-image

compounds.formula: Ie > Op, Ie - Th - Sd - Sb - Ll
compounds.name: Olive recollection
compounds.reading: The index of equivocity (Ie: husband or god?) breaks into the opsign (Ie > Op: Penelope's look across the fire, valence 1, a dead end) and bonds to the theatrical figure (Th: the false wedding), strong destiny (Sd: the bed remembered, the orchard walked), the symbol (Sb: the olive bed) and the limit of the large form (Ll: the last blow withheld).

compound_whole.formula: Ic - Ve > Ba - Bi - Mk > Lo
compound_whole.name: The Odyssey, whole
compound_whole.reading: Measured over the whole cut by the same rule: the icon (Ic) and the vector (Ve) open it, bodies of attitude (Ba) are the first break, the duel (Bi) and the mark (Mk) carry the middle, and it ends in limpid and opaque (Mk > Lo): a film of action whose one crystal is disguise.

proposals.proposal: Keep the Phaeacian hall in the film as the tales' frame: return to the listening hall at the end of each book of tales (after the Cyclops, after Circe, the intermezzo in XI, at the end of XII). Each return is a mise en abyme (Ma); played with the key beat's irony (the teller is the liar), the frame becomes powers of the false (Pf).
proposals.why: From IX-S02 to XII-S07 the film is twenty-six minutes of action-images with no frame; the Apologoi are the one place the poem itself asks whether the story is true.

proposals.proposal: Stage the dead as regions of the past, not as a queue of interviews: long lateral tracks, each group of shades in its era's dress, the mist continuous, no cut back to a present-day establishing shot.
proposals.why: Assigned already; the renderer's default (auto coverage WIDE/MID/CLOSE per segment) would turn it back into a dialogue scene.

proposals.proposal: Drop the bed (score) entirely under the song; alternate the song-held wide with the deaf crew's silent point of view (Op).
proposals.why: The only scene in the poem built on the split between opsign and sonsign.

proposals.proposal: Hold Odysseus on the shore as a body of attitude before any line is spoken; give Ogygia an empty any-space-whatever wide (V-S01) so the island is felt as suspended time.
proposals.why: Ogygia is the film's first image of Odysseus: seven years in one posture.

proposals.proposal: Cut XIX-S04 and XIX-S05 as one circuit: hold the hand on the scar, dissolve (marked) into the hunt, dissolve back to the dropped foot. The dissolve is a new renderer capability (see motion: transitions).
proposals.why: The Auerbach digression is the poem's model recollection-image; the cut already keeps both scenes.

proposals.proposal: Treat each recognition by its own test: Helen (IV) and Argos (XVII) as icons, Telemachus (XVI) as limpid and opaque (no memory), Eurycleia (XIX) as the index of lack opening a recollection, Penelope (XXIII) and Laertes (XXIV) as strong destiny through a marked flashback.
proposals.why: Recognitions are the film's summit events; a single 'emotional close-up' treatment would flatten six different signs into one icon.

proposals.proposal: Render Theoclymenus's vision inside the ordinary feast, not as a cut-away: the blood on the walls and the shades in the doorway in the same wide as the laughing suitors.
proposals.why: The film's only peaks of the present; marking it as a dream (Rd) would lose it.

proposals.proposal: Play Helen's tale (IV-S03) and Menelaus's (IV-S04) back to back without ranking them: the same Troy set, contradictory Helens.
proposals.why: The Telemachy's one time-image, and it costs nothing: both scenes are kept.
